method: Matched production bundles, same frozen Exit snapshot and camera trajectories. Native quality with normal structural shadows; no adaptive reduction. Same hardware browser, fresh contexts, before/after order alternates by episode. 30 warmup frames, five seconds measured. DPR 1 and 1.5. The new ratio obeys the regional GPU budget; the reference uses the previous pixel cap. CPU submission excludes asynchronous GPU completion. No concurrent tests/benchmarks.
changes: Select live regional-lighting backing dimensions from the 64 MiB GPU budget, with rounded dimensions and 1 MiB shadow-geometry headroom. DPR 1 stays unchanged in the measured viewport.
Preflight oversized viewports without permanently disabling GPU rendering; release inactive Canvas/GPU-resolve storage when changing backends.
Reuse existing foreground occlusion artwork in the visible night frame for eligible ordinary contexts. No new image buffers.
Observe ambient-only readable ink in the normal paint traversal; omit its correction replay when absent. Charging-bay correction remains intact.

visual.method: Current renderer versus its original-composition options (reuseObjectArtwork:false, skipEmptyAmbientPass:false), at matching GPU backing dimensions. Separate from before/after FPS comparison.
visual.checks: Both field backends; water, subpixel camera movement, props, fading player, EMP, crouch/facing, charging bays, inherited alpha, max blending, context loss, unavailable/software WebGL, palette easing and regional gradient checks passed.

validation.productionBuild: passed, including validation of 45 built-in levels
validation.lint: passed for all touched source and tests
validation.budgetRecovery: Budget-limited 1789x1118 Canvas viewport restores GPU at 1280x800 and releases Canvas fields.
validation.gameplayRoutes: No complete Exit route was performed; normal-input swimming is a diagnostic probe.

limitations: Hardware Edge on this Windows ARM machine; other user applications remained open. No concurrent tests/benchmarks during timing.
Three matched episodes per arm/workload/DPR. Results vary; retain ranges and do not infer locked 60 FPS.

High-DPI backing resolution changes from 1789x1118 Canvas to 1577x986 GPU; CSS layout, light curves, palette, effects and four-sample shadows are retained. Matching-resolution pixel checks do not imply identical sharpness at different resolutions.
Renderer CPU spans exclude asynchronous GPU completion. Buffer counters exclude driver/browser copies and total process memory.
Rendering probes hold world state fixed; swimming uses a diagnostic in-memory entrance, normal input and the usual accumulator/time cap. Physics was not changed.
React UI, audio, persistence and input latency are excluded. The level snapshot is frozen so ongoing author edits do not contaminate the comparison.
